description: Golden set for search algorithm evaluation (issue #55). Each case records must_include (law_id that must appear in top-N), must_exclude (law_id that must NOT appear), and expected completeness. Queries use the live Pages index via tools/search_eval.mjs.

cases.name: exact-phrase-keeps-negation
cases.note: 公園条例第14条 must rank; 下水道事業会計規則第51条 (還付した) must not be an exact hit

cases.name: amount-unit-not-bigram-coincidence
cases.note: 600点 and 500万円 in the same table must not satisfy 600万円

cases.name: unit-variant-still-matches
cases.note: The same table must match its own 600点

cases.name: multi-term-chunk-scope
cases.note: No law contains both terms in one chunk in the current corpus; count=0 with completeness=complete is correct

cases.name: appendix-reachable
cases.note: Appendix tables must be searchable, not only article bodies

cases.name: single-char-query-rejected
cases.note: Bigram index cannot answer 1-char queries; must be an explicit error, not count=0

cases.name: nonsense-query-zero-vs-partial
cases.note: True zero: completeness must be complete, not partial
